document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
A  hundred  yards  from  camp,  you  spot  a  Canada  goose. 
Steadying your shaky hand for a moment, you take the shot. 
You dare not aim for the head and miss, so you put a bullet in 
its gut. The agonized beast leads you on a fretful chase through 
the woods before keeling over.

You return to Norman elated. A good meal is exactly what 
he needs.

Make a Hard CON roll for Norman: if he succeeds, go to 543; if he 
fails, you arrive too late, go to 67.
